about: Portage la Prairie is a city in southern Manitoba on the Assiniboine River, about an hour west of Winnipeg along the Trans-Canada Highway. Prairie agriculture, a historic Main Street, and a role as a regional service centre for the Portage Plains define the community. About 13,000 people live in Portage la Prairie.
